tools.name: cobaltintelligence_list_states
tools.description: List the state names the other tools accept, from Cobalt's search index. Call this first to pick a valid state. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search/index.

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_search_businesses
tools.description: Find business entities in one state whose name matches search_query. Returns candidate matches; pick one, then call cobaltintelligence_get_business or cobaltintelligence_get_business_by_sos_id. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search/list. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_business
tools.description: Get the Secretary of State record for one business name in one state. Add city or zip to narrow a common name. A slow search returns a retryId; check it with cobaltintelligence_get_search_result. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_business_by_sos_id
tools.description: Get the Secretary of State record for one filing id (SOS id) in one state. Use the id from cobaltintelligence_search_businesses or a previous record. A slow search returns a retryId. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search?sosId=. Entity records only. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Do not use it to screen

tools.name: cobaltintelligence_get_search_result
tools.description: Check a search that returned a retryId. Makes one call and does not wait. Call again later if the status is still Incomplete. Cobalt API: GET /v1/search?retryId=.
